title: Borrowed eyes: each committee member's from-scratch trunk is replaced by ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small blocks (BSD-3, baked in model/pretrained), fine-tuned at a tenth of the learning rate, so the place descriptor starts from invariances learned on a million photographs instead of three
hypothesis: Eleven experiments on this ruler have moved every stage except the one that decides what a place looks like. The held-out 2024 usable-fix rate has sat in a 6-14% band through all of them (exp 2: 7.0, exp 4: 11.75, exp 5: 12.5, exp 6: 14.2, exp 7: 7.5, exp 8: 9.2, exp 10: 6.3, exp 11: 10.75) while everything around it swung: training-survey fit at the same held-out viewpoints ranged 18% to 95% usable (exp 5 lifted it to 72-81% and 2024 stayed at 12.5%; exp 11 lifted it to 65-77% and 2024 read 10.75%), and the gate took 2024 false fixes from 43% to 7% (exps 7 and 11) without touching usable. The champion's own survey diagnostic says why: after the cosine head, each member still names the same cell for the same place in all three TRAINING surveys only 43-46% of the time (xsurvey_agree, clean lattice crops, heading 0), its within-place variance fraction did not move (0.286 vs 0.295 in exp 7; exp 11 predicted < 0.15), and clean per-survey top1 is 57-67% on photographs it trained on. Three fingerprints per tile remain the solution the trunk finds, whatever head, gate or auxiliary sits on it (exps 3, 8, 9, 10 all tried to pull the feature together and none bit), because the trunk itself - four plain 3x3 stride-2 convs, 150k parameters, initialised at random, 'Feature extractor' changed:true only once in this era (exp 5, which added depth on top of the same four layers) - has only ever seen three photographs of one city and has no reason to prefer the structure they share over the texture that tells them apart. This experiment changes what the trunk IS: each member's conv stack becomes torchvision's MobileNetV3-Small stem + first eight inverted-residual blocks (features[0..8], IMAGENET1K_V1, BSD-3, 190,520 parameters, 128x128 -> 48x8x8, same 8x8 grid and stride-16 the current trunk produces), followed by a trainable 1x1 lift 48->112 so the exp-11 cosine head, prototypes, offset head, pooling and committee gate are byte-for-byte the same design. The pretrained blocks are fine-tuned at a tenth of the head's learning rate so the invariances they arrive with are adapted to Berlin, not overwritten by it. The weights are already in the repository (model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt, 195,168 values, verbatim torchvision tensors, loaded strict in the four-area era by commit 2d6f2cd's _build_pretrained_trunk, and the AWS code package ships the whole model/ directory, so nothing is downloaded on the box). Why this is the family the evidence points at and not another training signal: the one external representation this era has measured (exp 8's probe, three TRAINING captures only) found a place across surveys 95% of the time when aligned, 70% under the eval's 12 px shift and 23% under shift+rotation, against 90% / 7-11% / 1% for raw pixels - features learned on natural images at scale carry both the cross-survey and the off-lattice tolerance the eval demands, and exp 8 failed not because that was wrong but because a 1M-parameter student could not absorb it through distillation (student-teacher cosine 0.40 against 0.55 needed). Deploying pretrained features directly sidesteps distillation entirely: the invariance is in the weights on day one, and fine-tuning at 0.1x only has to attach Berlin's 2,970 prototypes to it. MobileNetV3-Small at features[0..8] is the right slice for this harness, not DINOv2: it is a CNN the ESP32-P4 toolchain ingests, its slice fits the 4 MiB gate twice over with the full 112-d head (design-stage sizing on the exact graph, runs/_probe_exp12_pretrained.py: two members export to 3,542,960 bytes, 3.38 MiB, 1,058,420 parameters, 1.3 ms host latency), and it is permissively licensed. Honest reading of the earlier-era record: the four-area era ran this trunk for ~30 experiments (its src_ids 11-40) and those models re-score at 1.77-2.00 on this ruler, but every one of them was trained on ONE photograph under a sigmoid confidence head that never abstains (false fix 77-99%, usable 0-0.5%), so their numbers measure a broken gate, not the trunk's cross-survey behaviour; the trunk has never been trained on three surveys, never under the committee gate, never under the cosine head, and never under paired batches with photometric randomisation. This is the 'change what the trunk is' move that exp 11's own decision rule (b) named for the case that compactness across three surveys did not reach a fourth, and that exp 7's rule (a) named as the accuracy move once the gate was in place; both conditions now hold. The deployed graph changes (new trunk, same head and decode); the training loss, targets, paired batches, augmentation, committee, schedule shape and views per epoch do not. Library L2 lists pretrained-feature routes as the largest documented effect in the scene-coordinate literature (ACE-G / R-SCoRe); this is that route in its deployable form.
method: model/model.py: Member.features (four from-scratch stride-2 convs at MEMBER_CHANS) is replaced by trunk = mobilenet_v3_small(weights=None).features[:9] with the state dict loaded strict from model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt (prefix 'features.' stripped), followed by lift = Conv2d(48, 112, 1, bias=False) + BatchNorm2d + ReLU; ImageNet mean/std normalisation is applied to the [0,1] input inside Member.embed via registered buffers so the ONNX contract is unchanged. embed_bn, prototypes [n_cells x 112], off_head, forward(), the committee decode, loss_fn and export_onnx are untouched. model/train.py: the optimiser gets two parameter groups - the pretrained trunk blocks at 1e-3 * TRUNK_LR_MULT (0.1) and everything else at 1e-3 - under a LambdaLR with the same cosine shape as today's schedule (multiplier 1.0 -> 0.1 over the run, i.e. head 1e-3 -> 1e-4 as now, trunk 1e-4 -> 1e-5); train_info records init = pretrained and the trunk description. Nothing else changes: paired-survey chunks, augment_views, tent targets, residual offset targets, two members with independent augmentation draws, survey_diag, epochs, batch size.
expected_outcome: Mechanical checks that must hold or the mechanism did not bite: the training log prints a line confirming the strict load of model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt for both members; exported bytes read ~3,542,960 (design-stage mock of the exact graph; anything above 4,194,304 is an implementation error, not a result) and host latency ~1.5 ms; per-member augmented top1 at epoch 8 is at or above exp 11's 0.58 (a pretrained init fits faster, not slower) and the member agreement rate on training views is at or above exp 11's 0.54. The diagnostic the mechanism is aimed at: each member's clean cross-survey argmax agreement (xsurvey_agree, same cell named in all three training surveys) rises from exp 11's 0.43-0.46 to above 0.55 by epoch 8, and the within-place variance fraction (wpv) falls from 0.286 to below 0.22 - i.e. the pretrained features describe a place more alike across the three surveys than the from-scratch features did. Primary (held-out truedop_2024): 0.963 -> predicted 0.85-0.95, through usable_fix_rate: 10.75% -> 15-25%, with false_fix_rate 7% -> 6-12% (both members start from the same ImageNet weights, so they are less diverse than two random inits and will agree more often on 2024 frames; the bet is that the extra agreement is enriched for correct fixes because the shared features are survey-invariant, and the committee's logged agreement rate is the check). 2024 coverage: 0.1775 -> 0.25-0.40. 2024 median error among confident frames (55 m) stays below 100 m. train_capture_diagnostics (bb_dop20 / truedop_2022 / truedop_2023 = 0.358 / 0.373 / 0.253 on exp 11, usable 66 / 65 / 77%) are predicted to IMPROVE to 0.20-0.35 (usable 70-85%); the evidence that matters is the gap between those three numbers and the 2024 score narrowing, not the training numbers alone. Decision rules: (a) 2024 usable up by >= 4 points with false fix <= 12% -> supported; the next experiment either extends the slice to features[0..9] at a narrower embedding (96 ch at 4x4, whole-frame receptive field, exp 5's finding transplanted onto invariant features; sizing in the probe: needs D <= 80 to fit) or lowers the trunk multiplier further / freezes the stem and blocks 1-3 to keep more of the ImageNet invariance. (b) xsurvey_agree > 0.55 but 2024 usable flat (<= 12.5%) -> ImageNet features fine-tuned on three surveys still describe a fourth differently; retry once with the trunk FROZEN (linear-probe regime, TRUNK_LR_MULT 0) to separate 'the features cannot do it' from 'fine-tuning destroyed them' before closing the family; if that is flat too, move to survey-bagged members (each member trained on two of the three surveys, giving an in-training foreign-survey signal for the gate). (c) per-member top1 < 0.45 at epoch 8 -> the trunk cannot adapt at 0.1x or the 48->112 lift is the bottleneck; retry once with TRUNK_LR_MULT 1.0, nothing else changed. (d) false fix rises above 14% with usable up -> the two members share ImageNet-derived confusions; the next experiment restores diversity by giving the members different pretrained slices (features[0..7] vs [0..8]) or different frozen depths, not by reverting to from-scratch. (e) the box fails on 'import torchvision' or on the weight file -> infrastructure (torchvision is in the Modal image and the AWS Deep Learning PyTorch AMI; the code package ships model/pretrained), not a verdict; rerun. Standing check: the score must move through usable_fix_rate; an improvement through false_fix_rate alone with usable flat means the pretrained features made the members more honest, not more knowledgeable - still kept, but rule (b) applies to the next design.
init_strategy: pretrained:mobilenet_v3_small IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..8] (torchvision, BSD-3; model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt, fine-tuned at 0.1x LR) + from-scratch 1x1 lift, cosine head, offset head
eli5: Until now the drone's two 'navigators' had eyes that were grown from scratch by looking at only three aerial photographs of Berlin, so they learned those three photographs' quirks - that day's shadows, that camera's colours - and a fourth photograph of the same streets looked foreign to them. This experiment gives each navigator eyes that have already looked at about a million ordinary photographs and learned what edges, roads, roofs and textures look like in general, under all kinds of light and seasons; we then teach those eyes Berlin on top, gently, so the general knowledge is not overwritten. The hope is that eyes which already ignore lighting and season will recognise a Berlin street in a photograph they have never seen, which is exactly the test. Everything after the eyes - how the two navigators vote, how confidence is decided - stays the same.

stages.name: Camera frame
stages.detail: 128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw

stages.name: Feature extractor
stages.detail: NEW: two independent copies of the first nine blocks of MobileNetV3-Small, pre-trained on ImageNet (a million everyday photographs; open BSD-3 licence) and gently fine-tuned on Berlin at a tenth of the usual learning rate; each turns the frame into a 48-channel 8×8 map, lifted to a 112-number description of the place. Same 8×8 grid as before, now built from eyes that already know what roads, roofs and edges look like under any light

stages.name: Map-cell classifier
stages.detail: each extractor's description is centred, scaled to unit length and compared by angle against one unit-length reference direction per map tile (~3,000 tiles, 128 m each) - a compass, not a lookup table; the angle match times a fixed sharpness (30) is the tile score. The two members' tile-belief maps are averaged to pick the tile

stages.name: Local belief pooling
stages.detail: gathers the averaged belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre

stages.name: Within-cell offset
stages.detail: small head per member that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot; the two nudges are averaged

stages.name: Confidence gate
stages.detail: confidence = the SMALLER of the two members' belief on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours — both navigators must independently back the same place; if either one spreads its belief elsewhere the drone abstains

stages.name: Training signal
stages.detail: NEW only in how fast the eyes learn: the pre-trained blocks are tuned at a tenth of the learning rate of everything else (both decaying on the same cosine curve), so Berlin is added to the general knowledge rather than replacing it. The angular-margin tile loss, offset loss, paired three-survey batches, re-photographing, targets, epochs and views per epoch are unchanged; the end-of-epoch check still logs how often each member names the same tile in every survey

implementation_brief:
ONE change: each committee member's from-scratch conv trunk becomes an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small slice (features[0..8]) + a trainable 1x1 lift to 112 channels, fine-tuned at 0.1x LR. Everything else in model/ stays as it is. A working skeleton of the exact Member and the strict weight load is in runs/_probe_exp12_pretrained.py (design-stage sizing probe; copy its trunk/lift construction and key-prefix stripping); the four-area era's original loader is `git show 2d6f2cd:model/model.py` (_build_pretrained_trunk, IMAGENET_MEAN/STD buffers) - lift from either, do not re-derive.

=== model/model.py ===
1. Imports: add `from pathlib import Path` and `from torchvision.models import mobilenet_v3_small`.
2. Constants: REMOVE `MEMBER_CHANS` and add
   EMBED_DIM = 112                      # lift output / prototype / offset-head width (unchanged from exp 11's 112)
   TRUNK_BLOCKS = 9                     # mobilenet_v3_small.features[:9] = stem + 8 inverted-residual blocks -> 48 x 8 x 8 at 128 px
   TRUNK_OUT_CH = 48
   PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "pretrained" / "mnv3s_features8.pt"
   TRUNK_LR_MULT = 0.1                  # pretrained blocks train at this multiple of the head LR
   IMAGENET_MEAN = (0.485, 0.456, 0.406); IMAGENET_STD = (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)
   Keep CELL_PX, N_MEMBERS, COS_SCALE, COS_MARGIN exactly as they are.
3. Add a module-level helper:
   def build_pretrained_trunk() -> nn.Sequential:
       trunk = mobilenet_v3_small(weights=None).features[:TRUNK_BLOCKS]
       sd = torch.load(PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
       trunk.load_state_dict({k[len("features."):]: v for k, v in sd.items()}, strict=True)
       return trunk
   (The baked file's 168 keys are all prefixed `features.`; strict=True must pass - the probe verified it does with torchvision 0.28. Call it once PER MEMBER so each member owns an independent copy of the weights; do not share modules between members.)
4. Member.__init__(self, n_cells): replace the `layers`/self.features construction with
   self.trunk = build_pretrained_trunk()
   self.lift = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(TRUNK_OUT_CH, EMBED_DIM, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(EMBED_DIM), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
   self.register_buffer("in_mean", torch.tensor(IMAGENET_MEAN).view(1, 3, 1, 1))
   self.register_buffer("in_std", torch.tensor(IMAGENET_STD).view(1, 3, 1, 1))
   and keep self.embed_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(EMBED_DIM), self.prototypes = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(n_cells, EMBED_DIM)) with the same normal_(std=0.01) init, self.off_head = nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM, 2). Drop the `chans` argument.
5. Member.embed(self, x): `f = self.lift(self.trunk((x - self.in_mean) / self.in_std)).mean(dim=(2, 3))`; `e = F.normalize(self.embed_bn(f), dim=1)`; return (e, f) - same signature, survey_diag depends on it. The input x stays float [0,1]; the normalisation is inside the graph so the ONNX contract is unchanged.
6. Add two helpers on Member for the optimiser: `trunk_parameters()` -> self.trunk.parameters(); `head_parameters()` -> parameters of lift, embed_bn, prototypes, off_head (everything not in self.trunk).
7. Member.forward, CellLocNet (block_mask, training_outputs, forward/committee decode), build_model, loss_fn, export_onnx, estimate_position: UNCHANGED. Update the module docstring: add a short 'PRETRAINED TRUNK (experiment 12)' paragraph (what the slice is, BSD-3, baked file, 0.1x LR, ImageNet normalisation baked in as buffers) and fix the committee paragraph's 'each its own conv trunk at MEMBER_CHANS' wording. Leave the ONNX contract paragraph verbatim.

=== model/train.py ===
8. Import line: replace MEMBER_CHANS with EMBED_DIM, TRUNK_LR_MULT, PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH (and TRUNK_BLOCKS if you log it).
9. Optimiser in train_area(): replace `opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)` with two groups:
   trunk_params = [p for m in model.members for p in m.trunk_parameters()]
   head_params  = [p for m in model.members for p in m.head_parameters()]
   opt = torch.optim.Adam([{"params": trunk_params, "lr": 1e-3 * TRUNK_LR_MULT}, {"params": head_params, "lr": 1e-3}])
   Assert the two lists together cover every parameter of model exactly once (len check against model.parameters()).
10. Scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR(eta_min=1e-4) would pin the trunk group at a constant 1e-4; replace it with a LambdaLR of the SAME shape for both groups: `sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(opt, lambda e: 0.1 + 0.9 * 0.5 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * e / epochs)))` (import math). That reproduces today's head schedule (1e-3 -> 1e-4 over the run, stepped once per epoch exactly as now) and gives the trunk 1e-4 -> 1e-5. The `lr=` in the epoch log line should print the HEAD group's LR (opt.param_groups[1]) so it stays comparable with earlier logs; add `trunk_lr=` next to it.
11. After build_model(), print one line: `[berlin] trunk: mobilenet_v3_small features[0..8] IMAGENET1K_V1 loaded strict from <PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH.name> x N_MEMBERS members, lift 48->112, trunk lr x0.1` (this is the mechanical check the pre-registration reads from the log).
12. train_info dict: set "init" to "pretrained:mobilenet_v3_small IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..8] (torchvision, BSD-3), fine-tuned at 0.1x LR"; replace the "member_chans" key with "trunk": "mobilenet_v3_small features[0..8] + 1x1 lift 48->112", add "embed_dim": EMBED_DIM, "trunk_lr_mult": TRUNK_LR_MULT, "pretrained_file": PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH.name; extend the "capture_sampling" string with ", ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small trunk per member (0.1x LR)". Update the module docstring with a short 'PRETRAINED TRUNK (experiment 12)' paragraph.
13. UNCHANGED and must stay so: CHUNK_SIZE, BATCH_SIZE, AUG and augment_views(), load_scene() (reads ONLY buckets(meta, "train") - the eval capture must never be opened), chunk_views(), gpu_crops(), make_soft_targets(), residual_offset_target(), run_epoch() (members still get independent augment_views draws; logits_k = COS_SCALE * cos_k; loss_fn(cos_k, ...)), survey_diag() (uses member.embed and member.prototypes - both keep their names and shapes), the CLI (--area, --out-dir, --data-dir, --epochs, --max-crops-per-bucket, --seed), export to <out>/models/<area>.onnx, train_info.json append semantics.
14. The pretrained trunk's BatchNorm layers stay in train mode during training (model.train() as now) so their running stats adapt to aerial imagery; survey_diag's model.eval()/restore logic already handles the switch. Do not freeze anything in this experiment (TRUNK_LR_MULT = 0.1, not 0).

=== contracts (frozen scorer depends on these) ===
- ONNX: <out>/models/<area>.onnx, input "frame" 1x3x128x128 float32 in [0,1], output "uvc" [[u, v, conf]], u/v normalised map coords in [0,1], conf in [0,1]; opset 17, dynamo=False. The decode (softmax -> argmax -> 3x3 block mask -> pooled centroid -> offset -> min-over-members conf) stays inside the graph.
- Gates: exported bytes must be <= 4,194,304 (expected ~3,542,960 with EMBED_DIM 112; if the export unexpectedly exceeds the gate, set EMBED_DIM = 96 -> ~3,156,272 bytes, and say so in the log) and host latency <= 250 ms (expected ~1.5 ms).
- CLI of model/train.py unchanged: python -m model.train --area berlin --out-dir runs/<id> [--epochs N] [--max-crops-per-bucket N] [--seed N] [--data-dir P].
- torchvision is required at train time (present in .venv locally: 0.28.0; in the Modal image; in the AWS Deep Learning PyTorch AMI). Hardswish/SE blocks export cleanly at opset 17 and run in onnxruntime (verified by the probe).

=== sanity run before handing back ===
Run `.venv/bin/python -m model.train --area berlin --out-dir /tmp/exp12_smoke --epochs 1` only if a smoke path exists in the harness; otherwise at minimum build the model in a Python one-liner, assert the strict load succeeded, export the ONNX to a temp file, check its size against 4,194,304 and run one onnxruntime inference on a zeros frame to confirm the [[u, v, conf]] output. Do not open any file under data/berlin that belongs to the eval capture (truedop_2024).
